## Features map (notes/features, outside git) (105)

| id | name | where | kind | group | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `feat:f1` | START.cmd launcher | H:\VRG\START.cmd | app · tier 1 | Front doors | The front door: tools, projects, dev menu, local servers, prompts, Zen sessions and commit + push, all from one menu registry (launcher/vrg-menu.json). |
| `feat:f2` | Local servers menu | START → O | feature · tier 1 | Front doors | 17 helper servers with fixed ports (Planner 8131, Inventory 8123, MindMap 8124 …); a key starts one if it is down, then opens it. |
| `feat:f3` | Commit + upload guard | START → S | feature · tier 1 | Front doors | Commits the current branch and pushes it, never touches main on GitHub, never forces; secrets and files over 5 MB stop it. Q asks before leaving unpushed work. |
| `feat:f4` | BACKUP menu | H:\VRG\BACKUP.cmd | app · tier 1 | Front doors | Sync to H:\VRG\Backup with a SHA-256 manifest, git fsck, restore of one file or folder, installer check. |
| `feat:f5` | Zen work sessions | START → Z | feature · tier 2 | Front doors | Opens tab groups in Zen: online workplace, main tools, tools in development, or all three. |
| `feat:f6` | Prompt library | START → J | feature · tier 2 | Front doors | Ready prompts (new feature, debugging, phase a big task, review …); the chosen one is shown and copied. |
| `feat:f7` | Launcher check | START → X | dev · tier 2 | Front doors | tools/check-start.js checks every menu path and port whenever tools move. |
| `feat:f8` | VRG Kapu | START → H · Hub/dist/vrg-kapu.html | app · tier 3 | Front doors | The shared access page: GitHub sign-in, a signed allowed list, then it hands over to START. Lists START's tools with Megnyitás and Mappa. |
| `feat:f9` | Kapu admin | START → O → M · :8798 | dev · tier 3 | Front doors | Edits and signs the allowed list. |
| `feat:f10` | OTG menu | H:\VRG\OTG.cmd (shown, phase 3.6) | plan · tier 4 | Front doors | Build a dist, pick a drive, copy + verify, safe eject: the toolset on a stick. |
| `feat:f11` | run.exe |  | plan · tier 4 | Front doors | The launcher as a real program instead of a .cmd, reading the same registry. |
| `feat:f12` | VRG Desktop Dashboard | notes/features/DASHBOARD-IDEA.md | idea · tier 5 | Front doors | The all-in-one windowless HTML: every feature, stats, dev and project workflows to start or continue, links to programs, folders and documents. Reads this map'… |
